# Turn a payment spreadsheet into a SEPA bulk payment file

> Free CSV to SEPA converter: turn a spreadsheet of supplier or payroll payments into a pain.001 XML file for your bank's bulk upload. Checks every IBAN and amount first, writes exact control totals, and never uploads your list.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
